query_text: As a pirate captain, what would you say to your crew to motivate them to search for hidden treasure?

content.text:
Arrr, gather 'round, ye brave souls! 🏴‍☠️

Listen up, every last one of ye, for yer captain has words that'll set yer hearts ablaze!

**The Call of Fortune!**
We didn't brave these savage seas, battle howling storms, and cheat the depths of Davy Jones' locker just to sail home empty-handed! Nay! There be treasure out there — gold and jewels beyond yer wildest dreams — and it's got OUR names written on it!

**The Brotherhood of the Sea!**
Every one of ye is the finest crew to ever hoist a sail! I'd trust ye with me life — and I HAVE! We've faced cannonballs, sea monsters, and the King's own navy together. If anyone can find this treasure, it's THIS crew, on THIS ship!

**The Promise of Reward!**
When we crack open that chest, every soul aboard gets their rightful share! No man — or woman — gets left behind. Ye'll have enough gold to buy yer own island, retire like a king, and STILL have doubloons left over to spend at every port from here to the Caribbean!

**The Legacy!**
They'll sing songs about us in every tavern from here to the ends of the earth! The greatest pirates who ever lived — the ones who found the treasure that NO ONE else could find! Our names will echo through history!

So sharpen yer cutlasses, keep yer eyes on the horizon, and TRUST the map in me hands! The X marks the spot, and glory awaits those bold enough to claim it!

**Now, are ye with me?! TO THE TREASURE! ⚓🗺️☠️**

*— Captain [Your Name Here], Terror of the Seven Seas*
